Spend your Cycles in the BIOS—a massive Hexagonal Grid Layout skill tree—to unlock game-changing Ultimate abilities like "Infinite Loop" or "Supernova". Defeating Bosses also grants Upgrade Points (Chips) for the Circuit tab to further optimize your build.
